title: A quiz answer moves your memory

steps.text: learn_queue picks due nodes, then the frontier of the fog.

check.note: queue(): due cards least-retrievable first, then up to `new` frontier nodes, learn.py:107-122@83a5621; reads learner_card, node (_candidates), edge (_frontier), learner_question (learn.py:126).

steps.text: A background subagent reads the code and writes each question with its private key.

check.note: prepare() inserts learner_question with prompt, private key, evidence (required), learn.py:149@83a5621; background subagent reading code is the quiz-prepare skill. Closed-book pin (convention) names the background subagent.

steps.text: You answer, with a confidence from 1 to 4, before seeing anything else.

check.note: skills/quiz/SKILL.md:29@9ecc008 asks answer + confidence 1-4; closed book at SKILL.md:11. Convention.

steps.text: Only then does the session fetch the key and grade the answer against it. This is a convention: learn_key itself does not check that the question was answered.

check.note: key() returns key+evidence with no answered_at check, learn.py:155-161@83a5621; ordering is convention (quiz SKILL.md:11,35), as the step now says.

steps.text: FSRS moves the node's card: the verdict and your confidence become the rating.

check.note: rating_for(verdict, confidence) -> review_card; UPDATE/INSERT learner_card card, due, level (+reviews, lapses, last_verdict), learn.py:182-199@83a5621. skipped/disputed move nothing.

steps.text: The answer is appended to the review log, which can never be edited.

check.note: INSERT learner_review learn.py:202@83a5621; triggers abort UPDATE/DELETE, db.py:171-174@83a5621 (same at be23b20). Pin bites on the table.

steps.text: Every later boot packet carries a line on what you know, for agents to calibrate to.

check.note: boot_packet adds learn.profile_line, __main__.py:57-59@83a5621; None until a card exists (learn.py:253-257). Reads learner_card (+node, learner_review). Decision pin fits.
